Holds back redrawing of a text area while you change a lot of it, which is faster and does not flicker. Call [UnlockTextArea](UnlockTextArea) afterwards.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Lock", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
area = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 270, 90, win)
LockTextArea area
For i = 1 To 200
	AddTextAreaText area, "Line " + i + Chr$(13)
Next
UnlockTextArea area
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param textarea  Handle of a text area.
@gap While a text area is locked it sends no events for the changes you make.
